summary: AEON Biopharma filed an 8-K (Other Events) reporting the partial exercise of the over-allotment option by underwriters in its July 15, 2026 public offering. On July 23, 2026, the company issued and sold 4,696,102 shares of Class A common stock at $0.0001 par value for additional gross proceeds of approximately $1.5 million, netting about $1.4 million after underwriting discounts. The underwriters had previously fully exercised the over-allotment option for two-year and five-year milestone warrants to purchase 6,403,290 shares or pre-funded warrants. This is a routine capital raise via an equity shelf takedown, not a special situation. No strategic event or structural change is involved.
